svg.aria-label: FoldWrite: the batch call reads the key's state once, applies the inputs to it in memory, and writes the result only if the store still holds the version it read. Another writer gets in first, so the write is refused; the round trip is retried, re-reads the new version and succeeds. Input 3 is invalid and is rejected on its own, without failing the others.
svg.text: read once · apply in memory · write if unchanged · retry the round trip
retry: back off, then repeat the whole round trip
one outcome per input: a bad input fails only itself
a conflict retries the whole round trip, which re-reads what landed; an invalid input fails only itself
